Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From f723fa4e69920f6a5dd5fa0d10ce90e2f14d189c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Christoph Hellwig <hch@lst.de>
Date: Tue, 5 Sep 2017 18:46:47 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] ahci: don't use MSI for devices with the silly Intel NVMe
 remapping scheme

Intel AHCI controllers that also hide NVMe devices in their bar
can't use MSI interrupts, so disable them.

Reported-by: John Loy <john.robert.loy@gmail.com>
Tested-by: John Loy <john.robert.loy@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Christoph Hellwig <hch@lst.de>
Fixes: d684a90d38e2 ("ahci: per-port msix support")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # v4.5+
Signed-off-by: Tejun Heo <tj@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/ata/ahci.c b/drivers/ata/ahci.c
index 5a5fd0b404eb..cb9b0e9090e3 100644
--- a/drivers/ata/ahci.c
+++ b/drivers/ata/ahci.c
@@ -1469,7 +1469,14 @@ static void ahci_remap_check(struct pci_dev *pdev, int bar,
 		return;
 
 	dev_warn(&pdev->dev, "Found %d remapped NVMe devices.\n", count);
-	dev_warn(&pdev->dev, "Switch your BIOS from RAID to AHCI mode to use them.\n");
+	dev_warn(&pdev->dev,
+		 "Switch your BIOS from RAID to AHCI mode to use them.\n");
+
+	/*
+	 * Don't rely on the msi-x capability in the remap case,
+	 * share the legacy interrupt across ahci and remapped devices.
+	 */
+	hpriv->flags |= AHCI_HFLAG_NO_MSI;
 }
 
 static int ahci_get_irq_vector(struct ata_host *host, int port)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/ata/ahci.c`**
   - A new warning message was added to inform users to switch their BIOS from RAID to AHCI mode if remapped NVMe devices are found.
   - A comment was added to clarify that the MSI-X capability should not be relied upon in the case of remapped devices.
   - A flag `AHCI_HFLAG_NO_MSI` was set in the `hpriv` structure to disable the use of MSI interrupts for devices that utilize the Intel NVMe remapping scheme.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications in `drivers/ata/ahci.c` are related in that they collectively address the issue of using MSI interrupts with Intel AHCI controllers that also manage NVMe devices. The added warning serves to inform users of the necessary BIOS configuration, while the comment and flag modification ensure that the driver does not attempt to use MSI interrupts in this scenario, thereby preventing potential issues with device communication. This patch effectively disables MSI for affected devices, ensuring stable operation.

        Root cause:
        The bug arises from the use of Message Signaled Interrupts (MSI) for Intel AHCI controllers that also manage NVMe devices through a remapping scheme. This scheme does not support MSI interrupts, leading to potential communication issues between the AHCI controller and the remapped NVMe devices.
